LanguageData.WFL_S_GovernanceTip: Lets Steward duties, succession, elections, schemes and house crime play out on their own. Turn off to keep only the records.
LanguageData.WFL_Protection_Waiting: {0} has received a protection offer. Their answer is waiting in Families.
LanguageData.WFL_Gov_ElectionNotPossible: An election needs elected leadership, no election already open, and two people the colony would accept.
LanguageData.WFL_Ask_Vote: An election is open. You can go and vote.

LanguageData.WFL_Ask_Heist: {0} asks whether you would take part in a job against another house.
LanguageData.WFL_Ask_Protection: {0} offers to protect your house for {1} silver every few days.

LanguageData.WFL_Ask_CouncilCensure: The council is asked whether to censure {0}.
LanguageData.WFL_S_CampingTip: Families may wish for a day or two away from the colony. You always decide: nothing is sent until you form the caravan yourself. Declining costs nothing.
LanguageData.WFL_S_CampRadius: Camping trip distance: up to {0} tiles from home
LanguageData.WFL_S_CampRadiusTip: How far from the colony a family may suggest camping.
LanguageData.WFL_Office_Tip: Acts of real work this term: {0}. Chosen with {1} for and {2} against. So far the year is judged: {3}. A post is kept by doing its work; it never changes what a person can do.
LanguageData.WFL_Ask_CouncilLeader: The council is choosing the colony's leader. Whom do you back?
LanguageData.WFL_Camp_LetterTitle: A family would like to go camping
LanguageData.WFL_Camp_LetterText: {0} and the {2} family would like a day or two away ({1}). Nothing happens unless you agree and send a caravan yourself.
LanguageData.WFL_CampMotive_ComingOfAge: to mark a coming of age
LanguageData.WFL_Camp_Line: Camping trip ({0}): {1}. About {2} hours. They would like to bring: {3}
LanguageData.WFL_Camp_Authorized: Agreed. Form a caravan and take it to the place shown on the world map. The trip counts once people have stayed there the whole time.
LanguageData.WFL_Camp_Unavailable: That camping trip can no longer be agreed to.
LanguageData.WFL_Camp_NeedHomeMap: Open one of your colony maps first, then form the caravan from there.
LanguageData.WFL_Camp_Good: The {0} family's camping trip was lovely. They are closer for it.
LanguageData.WFL_Camp_Fine: The {0} family's camping trip passed quietly.
LanguageData.WFL_Camp_Bad: The {0} family's camping trip went badly.
LanguageData.WFL_Camp_Cut: The {0} family's camping trip ended early.
LanguageData.WFL_Kin_StrandedTitle: Relatives held up on the road
LanguageData.WFL_Kin_StrandedText: Relatives of the {0} family, on their way to the reunion, are stuck on the road. A caravan that reaches them within about {1} days can help. If nobody comes, they will turn back and the reunion will go ahead without them.
LanguageData.WFL_Kin_Rescued: Help reached the {0} family's relatives. They are on their way again.
LanguageData.WFL_Kin_Failed: The {0} family's relatives did not make it to the reunion.
LanguageData.WFL_Kin_ArrivedText: Kin of the {0} family have arrived for the reunion: {1}. They will stay a few days, then go home.
LanguageData.WFL_S_ClassesTip: The colony's chosen teacher holds a class for the children every few days. The class waits if nobody is free to teach or to learn.
LanguageData.WFL_S_ClassEveryTip: How often the teacher holds a class.
LanguageData.WFL_S_AdultStudentsTip: Adults can be students too, when the teacher knows something they would like to learn. Off by default.
LanguageData.WFL_S_HealthChecksTip: The colony's chosen doctor examines everyone in the medical room. Someone examined recovers a little faster and fights illness a little better for a while.
LanguageData.WFL_S_CheckupsPerYearTip: A year here is 60 days; two rounds a year is one about every 30 days.
LanguageData.WFL_Checkup_Round: {0} has begun a round of check-ups.
LanguageData.WFL_Assembly_Text:
The families are gathering to choose the colony's posts. Everyone who can goes to the polling place to vote.
{0}
LanguageData.WFL_Assembly_RaceIncumbent: The {0}: {1} holds it, and has served {2}. Standing again.
LanguageData.WFL_Assembly_ResultKept: The {0}: {1} is kept on, having served {2}.
LanguageData.WFL_AssemblyState_Campaign: houses are choosing whom to back
LanguageData.WFL_Ask_AssemblyVote: The yearly assembly is voting on the colony's posts. Go and cast your ballot?
LanguageData.WFL_Chaplain_Named: {0}, the ideoligion's moral guide, is now the colony's chaplain.
LanguageData.WFL_Hall_Begins: {0} is serving a meal in the hall.
LanguageData.WFL_S_HallMealsTip: The colony's chosen hall keeper keeps the dining hall clean and serves meals to those who come and sit. Nothing starts unless the keeper is free.
LanguageData.WFL_S_HallEveryTip: How often the hall keeper calls people to a served meal.
LanguageData.WFL_Motive_Duty: asked because no one else would stand
LanguageData.WFL_HouseWish_Care: This house would like a {0} of its own: it has sick or hurt people to look after, or a gap in medical skill.
LanguageData.WFL_HouseWish_Teach: This house would like a {0} of its own: it has children to bring on, or a skill it wants taught.
LanguageData.WFL_HouseWish_Feed: This house would like a {0} of its own: it is short of food or wants its people at one table.
LanguageData.WFL_HouseWish_Standing: This house is seeking influence and would take a {0} for the standing it brings.
LanguageData.WFL_Perk_Healer: What it brings the house of the one who holds it: they are seen first at every round of check-ups, the check-up's good effect lasts twice as long for them, they are glad to be looked after by kin, and the house gains standing for each patient helped.
LanguageData.WFL_Perk_Teacher: What it brings the house of the one who holds it: their children are taught first and learn half as much again from every lesson, and the house gains standing for each class given.
LanguageData.WFL_Perk_HallKeeper: What it brings the house of the one who holds it: they are seated and served first, and are glad to be fed by their own, and the house gains standing for each meal served.
LanguageData.WFL_Perk_Chaplain: What it brings the house of the one who holds it: the holder is preferred to lead the family's rites, and the house gains standing for each rite led well.
LanguageData.WFL_Hall_Named: The hall is the room you named, at ({0}, {1}).
LanguageData.WFL_Hall_Auto: No hall named: the game looks for a dining room. A room with school furniture is never chosen.
LanguageData.WFL_Hall_Saved: That room is now the hall.
LanguageData.WFL_Hall_Invalid: That is not an enclosed room.
LanguageData.WFL_S_MindComfort: Loved ones help with mental breaks
LanguageData.WFL_S_MindComfortTip: A partner, or a parent, will try to talk someone through a mental break that is coming or has begun. How well it goes depends on how close they are and how good they are with people. They try a few times at most, and never during violent breaks.
LanguageData.WFL_Comfort_Resolved_0: {0} found the right words, and {1} came back to themselves.
LanguageData.WFL_Comfort_Resolved_1: {1} let {0} take their hand, and the storm passed.
LanguageData.WFL_Comfort_Resolved_2: With a few quiet words, {0} talked {1} down.
LanguageData.WFL_Comfort_Resolved_3: "I'm here," said {0}, and that was enough for {1}.
LanguageData.WFL_Comfort_Eased_0: {0} sat with {1}, who is calmer for it.
LanguageData.WFL_Comfort_Eased_1: {0} could not fix it, but {1} is no longer alone with it.
LanguageData.WFL_Comfort_Failed_0: {0} tried to reach {1}, but could not.
LanguageData.WFL_Comfort_Failed_1: Whatever {0} said, {1} was not ready to hear it.
